metadata.title: Exact hyperbola coordinates for the shared-p convolution
metadata.claim_status: Exact finite identities only; no asymptotic formula is claimed.

multiplicative_transform.note: The weight G is multiplicative, but the domain couples h,r,s through h*(r^2+s^2)<=2B and h may share primes with r*s.

progress: The B-dependent function L_B(p) has been eliminated from the summand.
The arithmetic weight is now the fixed multiplicative function G evaluated at h*r*s.
All B-dependence is isolated in an explicit quadratic height domain.
remaining_obstructions: Average G(h*r*s) over a coprime quadratic domain with h sharing primes with r*s.
Separate or control repeated-side chains before applying the global Mobius inversion.
Obtain an error term uniform enough for X=floor(B/k) across the Mobius range.
